summary: CooTek (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of a US 8-K) announcing board changes: Mr. Ye Yuan resigned as director effective November 6, 2026, citing personal reasons, and Ms. Lili Guo, the company's Head of Human Resources since July 2023, was appointed a director the same day. The board now comprises three directors. No terms, prices, stakes, advisor, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine, non-abrupt board refresh rather than a forced CEO/CFO departure, so no special-situation or risk-arb angle applies; watch subsequent 6-K/20-F disclosures for further governance or management changes.
